Hi Melissa,

We're sorry to hear that you have not seen the results you were hoping for.
It usually takes 6-8 weeks to see results but it really varies per
individual due to a lot of factors such as hair condition, stress,
environment, and genes. One of the common issues that may affect the
results though is using oil-based products on your lash area because oil
blocks the absorption of the serum and making it less effective. It is also
very important to use it twice daily for best results. If you have any
